name: mnemonic_particulate_instability
label: Mnemonic Particulate Instability
godotFeature: ShaderMaterial with custom vertex/fragment shaders leveraging 3D noise functions and global_position/time for dynamic material properties.
poeticVision: Feel the very fabric of memory fraying, a constant visual reminder of Lyra's slipping grasp. When a hunter approaches, the world around her, or the memory shard in her hand, shimmers with a granular instability, threatening to dissolve into a cloud of forgetfulness. It's a tactile representation of imminent loss, a visual pulse of identity under threat, where every surface holds the ghost of its own disappearance. The player constantly sees the precariousness of their reality.
usage: To use this shader, create a new ShaderMaterial resource in Godot. Load this .gdshader file into the 'Shader' property of the ShaderMaterial. Then, apply this ShaderMaterial to the 'material_override' or 'material' property of any MeshInstance3D node or other Spatial node that uses a mesh. You can dynamically update the 'dissolve_threshold' and 'instability_strength' uniform parameters from a GDScript to control the effect based on game state, such as Lyra's memory integrity or proximity to Silence hunters. For example, `material.set_shader_parameter("dissolve_threshold", current_memory_loss_factor);`

parameters.name: texture_albedo
parameters.description: The base albedo texture for the material. If not provided, 'albedo' color will be used.

parameters.name: albedo
parameters.description: The base color of the material. Used if no albedo texture is set, or multiplied with the texture.

parameters.name: instability_strength
parameters.description: Controls the maximum vertex displacement along the normal, creating a 'shimmering' or 'fraying' visual effect. Higher values mean more displacement.

parameters.name: noise_scale
parameters.description: Determines the frequency or 'granularity' of the noise pattern. Higher values result in finer, more detailed noise.

parameters.name: dissolve_threshold
parameters.description: Controls how much of the object is dissolved. A value of 0.0 means fully solid, while 1.0 means fully dissolved. This parameter should be dynamically driven by game state (e.g., Lyra's memory integrity).

parameters.name: dissolve_edge_width
parameters.description: The width of the glowing edge that appears around the dissolving parts of the object.

parameters.name: dissolve_edge_color
parameters.description: The color of the glowing edge around the dissolving parts.

parameters.name: time_speed
parameters.description: The speed at which the noise pattern evolves over time, creating a dynamic, flickering, or shimmering effect.

verdict: The very fabric of existence shimmers with the ghost of what was, a constant, beautiful whisper of impending oblivion.
impact: This invention will profoundly deepen the player's immersion into Lyra's struggle, transforming the environment into a dynamic, visual representation of her eroding identity and the constant, encroaching threat of the Silence. Every surface will pulse with the precariousness of reality, making the abstract concept of memory loss a tangible, unsettling presence that reinforces the game's core themes of survival and self-preservation. It will serve as a constant, visceral reminder of the stakes, enhancing both the adrenaline of the chase and the grief of self-loss.
